<quote by="Announced by Alexnadro von Temeschwar, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave">Opportunity to build the Silver Fox Mines, to support businesses and mines in Temeschwar. It is a great work and costs 50 weirwood, 50 white granite, and 25 thrones. It increases taxation by 5 thrones. Named the Silver Fox Mines and sponsored by the Crimson Reapers.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[great work]] in Locul, [[Temeschwar]]
* Announcement by the [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]]
* More information can be found in the '''[[Don%27t_blame_me#Tear_Out_the_Earth's_Heart|Don't blame me]]''' wind of fortune
* This commission has lapsed as of the start of the Summer Solstice 388YE

==Date==
* Summer 387YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 50 weirwood
* 50 white granite
* 300 crowns
* Six months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Silver_Fox_Mines}}
==Outcome==
* Once complete, the mines and businesses of the territory will provide 36 rings and two random ingots, respectively
* The [[Custodian of the Assayer's Guild]] will gain two additional ranks to their ministry
* Taxation from Temeschwar will increase by five thrones a season
